title: A Grey Literature Review of Graduate Students' Research Practices and Skills in the LLM Era
abstract: arXiv:2607.29519v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Context: Graduate students in computing now use Large Language Models (LLMs) throughout their research, from literature reviews and coding to data analysis and writing. Yet there is little shared understanding of which skills competent use of these tools requires, so graduate programs struggle to teach, mentor, or assess it, and unverified outputs can propagate into the scientific record.   Objective: We investigate which LLM-based practices graduate students employ in their research and which skills they need to benefit from these practices.   Method: We conducted a grey literature review of Reddit discussions. We retrieved 1,383 posts from five research-oriented subreddits, screened them against explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria, and analyzed the 54 included posts with thematic analysis, in which two authors independently coded each excerpt.   Results: We identified seven categories of practices and nine categories of skill

translated_title: LLM时代研究生研究实践与技能的灰色文献综述
translated_abstract: 背景：计算领域的研究生如今在整个研究过程中使用大型语言模型（LLM），涵盖文献综述、编码、数据分析和写作等环节。然而，对于熟练使用这些工具需要哪些技能，目前缺乏共识性理解，导致研究生培养项目难以对其开展教学、指导或评估，且未经核实的输出可能会渗透进科学记录中。目的：我们调查研究生在其研究中采用了哪些基于LLM的实践，以及他们需要哪些技能才能从这些实践中受益。方法：我们对Reddit讨论进行了灰色文献综述。我们从五个面向研究的子版块中检索了1,383个帖子，依据明确的纳入与排除标准进行筛选，并对纳入的54个帖子开展主题分析，由两位作者独立地对每个摘录进行编码。结果：我们识别出七类实践和九类技能。
tldr: 该研究通过对Reddit讨论的灰色文献综述，识别出研究生使用LLM开展研究的七类实践和九类所需技能，为研究生培养项目教授、指导和评估LLM使用能力提供了依据。
en_tdlr: This grey literature review of Reddit discussions identifies seven categories of LLM-based research practices and nine categories of skills graduate students need, informing how graduate programs can teach, mentor, and assess competent LLM use.
